Episode 158. Opening Ceremony (1)
January 15th, 1802.
In the blink of an eye, a year and a half has passed since Jin arrived in Lafrarosa.
Most of that time was spent purifying chaos, so Jin had only been able to fully devote himself to training for about two months. It had been from the moment Vahn accepted Lingling until now.
However, over the past two months, Jin had experienced a time of astonishing growth like never before.
"Haah, ha."
As Jin sheathed his sword, he caught his breath.
In front of him was a huge sword mark he had just left. It was a sword mark far deeper and more hideous than the one Temer had left on the training ground in the past.
Then, as always, an intense sense of exhaustion hit him and the fusion with Vahn was released.
For 10 minutes, Jin and Vahn could maintain their fusion at the highest level of harmony.
That meant, for 10 minutes, Jin was almost at his strongest state.
"How do you feel, Brother Jin?"
"I'm disappointed. I still have to rely on Sister Vahn's power for this level."
"You're talking big. If you say that somewhere else, you'll be resented."
"I know. Without you guys, where else could I be so lucky?"
Pouring everything into becoming stronger and feeling the joy of clear achievement every day. There could be no happier days for a martial artist.
Of course, the power available in the state of fusion with Vahn couldn't entirely be said to be Jin's.
However, what he had gained through training via the experiences and senses shared by Vahn at that time was definitely Jin's power.
'I thought so... after all, the ultimate skill of the Spirit Sword that I used when I defeated Lingling was not at a completed level.'
Vahn's experience.
The higher the harmony of fusion, the more vividly Jin was able to accept all of Vahn.
Thanks to that, he got a glimpse of the realization of the Spirit Sword and the King's Sword.
In other words, he had learned the Spirit Sword and King's Sword without a separate training process.

Of course, there was a huge gap between understanding in the head and actual application, so repeated training was required, but training with a clear grasp of the core promised overwhelming efficiency.
'Now, I can display a better Spirit Sword than before. And the King's Sword as well...'
Unlike the temporary strength gained through the devilishness of chaos, training through fusion with Vahn had no side effects.
'If I can keep growing like this, I can return faster than I thought.'
Rosa allowed him three years. Now that half of it has passed, he suddenly wondered how much has changed outside.
"What are you thinking about, Brother Jin?"
Boras, who had just entered the training ground, sat next to Jin and asked.
"Have you arrived, Brother Boras? I was thinking about the outside for a moment."
"You seem worried."
Jin shook his head.

"My mother, who is currently the acting head of my family, is not exactly friendly, but she is strong. She is a person who always takes responsibility for her words. I doubt there will be any problems with the family within these 3 years."
Jin trusted Rosa's obsession with the survival of Runcandel.
He believed that as long as Rosa was there, there wouldn't be any problems with Runcandel, even in his absence.
'...If it wasn't for my mother, coming to Lafrarosa would have required much more consideration.'
Looking back, the prestige of Runcandel he knew from his previous life had greatly faded.
To Jin at that time, Runcandel was an absolute fortress that would never fall. It didn't matter if one member of the family was missing.
But now it wasn't.

'My father and sister Luna have been absent since the Sword Emperor War, and the family does not have the same unity as before. It's because of me overthrowing Joshua, but it's a serious state just for that.'

The Kinzelo were hiding the existence of the Demon King Orgal and their power, Zipple was trying to transcend 'human' by producing a fleet and a magic stone, and even the empire was developing advanced mana technology to negotiate with such forces. All using Temar's body.
Only Runcandel was stagnant amidst all this.
This fact was clearly revealed in the Sword Emperor War. Runcandel couldn't live up to its name until the end of that terrible war.
He was astonished that Rosa, who was clearly his 'enemy', was supporting the family.
When I return, I will have to oust her and reorganize the entire family.
So that it can regain the glory of the old Runcandel, and restore the true form of the brilliant Runcandel.
"Brother Otuwang."
"Speak, Brother Tusin."
"Call all the brothers to the Tushinjeon."
Jin intuitively knew what Vahn was saying.
'Looks like he's about to start my match with the Tuwang brothers.'
He was slowly curious. How much difference is there between him and the Tuwang brothers now?
Until a year and a half ago, all of the Tuwang of the Myungwang clan had stronger force than Jin.
Even Teto, the Twelve Tuwang, almost toyed with and crushed Jin, even though it was a light match.
All other Tuwang are stronger than Teto.
"Do we move now?"
"No, we rest enough and go. Until we can spread Tushinjeon again."
"Yes."
A few hours later, as the two slowly headed to Tushinjeon, the already gathered brothers were seen waiting warmly.

When Vahn climbed the throne of the main hall, 76 people, excluding her, all the Myungwang tribes who were erased from history and survived, looked up at her. Their heart and Jin's shone even brighter than usual, resonating with Vahn's energy.
The radiance emanating from the Broad Hearts filled the space, yet the gathered landscape gave off a somewhat empty and lonely feeling.
Once, the vast arena of the Battle God Hall, as wide as a plain, was full of their light.
Now, if you look from afar, it would look like just a handful of light.
"The reason I gathered you all today is to commemorate."
Ring Ring also straightened his posture, sensing the atmosphere.
"Since our time stopped, the first to awaken us was Temar. But more than him, the one who allowed us to enjoy time, is our brother Jin here."
When the brothers nodded, Jin felt somewhat embarrassed.
Jin thought he had received much more from his brothers than what he had given them.
"And Jin has declared that he will bring us back into the world."
Although there are only clues at present and no sure means have been prepared, the Myungwang tribe had no doubt that Jin would definitely do so. Jin also believed in himself.
"Our history will start again soon. Therefore, I want to revive one tradition that we've forgotten for a long time. A tradition permitted only to the strongest of the strong."
"Oh, Ooh!"
"No way!"
The Myungwang tribe showed great excitement at Vahn's words.
"The revival of a history and tradition that will never be interrupted should naturally be started by Jin. You all think so, right?"
"Yes!"
When the Myungwang tribe answered powerfully, Vahn grinned and shouted.
"We will start the Battle King Tournament!"
While everyone was shouting, Jin had no choice but to ask Vahn quietly.
"Brother Battle God, what is the Battle King Tournament?"
"It's the greatest festival of the Myungwang tribe. As you can tell from the name, warriors fight against the Battle Kings. The same goes for the Battle Kings themselves."
"A fight? You mean it's not a sparring match?"
"Yes. The Battle King Tournament is the only fight where it is allowed to harm a brother with a weapon."
The Myungwang tribe does not calculate casualties.
Also, they never fight with the intent to kill each other.
Regardless of the form of dispute, problems between brothers are resolved through bare-handed combat, and even if weapons are used, it is only possible if they do not pose a lethal threat.
However, such taboos did not apply to the Battle King Tournament.
Of course, 'fratricide' is absolutely forbidden, but lethal injuries within treatable limits are allowed.
As Vahn explained, Jin tilted his head in wonder.
"Couldn't there be accidents? If you fight without so much restriction, you could kill each other."
"Accidents are inevitable."
"...Excuse me?"
"Unexpected accidents are naturally applicable to everything in the world."
Indeed, it was an answer befitting of a person who once said, "Training is originally something where you could die."

"We didn't always cherish each other as we do now, Brother Jin. There was a lot of betrayal, murder, conspiracy, and scheming in the history of the Myungwang tribe. It was just less than other races."
As always, Boras continued the explanation on behalf of Vahn.

"The era of the current Battle God, Sister Vahn, was literally a golden age for the Myungwang tribe. So there were no murders in the Battle King Tournament before its downfall, but it was not like that before. Factions divided and fought, and some even intentionally killed opponents to achieve political goals."
There were two reasons why the Myungwang tribe was enthusiastic about the revival of the Battle King Tournament.
Firstly, all the Battle King Tournaments held under the rule of the Battle Goddess Vahn were purely a clash of power, and secondly,
The revival of tradition was the realization of hope.
After being annihilated in opposition to the gods, the Myungwang tribe had only been living in this dead world like the dead.
Because there was no reason to continue traditions and festivals.
Vahn's revival of the Battle King Tournament symbolized his faith in Jin and the history of Lafrarosa, which would be liberated by him.
"Kyakyak, this time I will escape from being the weakest Battle King!"
"Wake up, twelve Battle King brothers."
"When will we start, Battle God Brother! Today? Tomorrow!?"
"We will start the opening ceremony immediately."
At Vahn's words, the eyes of the Battle Kings changed immediately.
They had a killing intent as if they wanted to kill Vahn in front of them right now.
'...It's not just a sparring session that's close to real combat, it's a look that really wants to kill Sister Vahn?'
Grrr...
When Vahn stomped once, suddenly the Battle God Hall separated from the other buildings and began to rise into the sky.
The Battle God Hall was transforming into a stage for the Battle King Tournament.
Of course, it was a series of shocks for Jin.
When the hall took its place in the middle of the sky, Vahn pointed to Jin.
"You all know, but the opening match of the Battle King Tournament originally starts with me fighting all the brothers."
"We are all ready."
"However, this time, I will have Brother Jin, who demonstrated the Battle God Fusion, take on that role."
No sooner had the words fallen, the killing intent from the Battle Kings and brothers that was directed at Vahn began to shift entirely towards Jin.
